data.name: Apoorva
data.long_meaning: Apoorva means new, fresh, and unparalleled. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'apoorva' which means 'unseen, unheard, unprecedented'. In Hindu mythology, Apoorva is a name given to the goddess of prosperity and good fortune, Lakshmi, who is believed to bring new beginnings and fresh opportunities.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the freshness and purity of new beginnings.
